Why agent harnesses need fast decisions — detailed note 1. In production AI, latency choices should be evidenced with paired evaluations, explicit latency definitions, and clear separation between vendor claims and independent measurements. TenthMatrix repeats this discipline across Insights pages so engineers can trust the surrounding narrative when they deep-link from Jobs, Agents, or Automation pages. When in doubt, open the Benchmark Lab filters and read the “what this does not prove” panel before citing a number externally.
